card.name: Contraindication condition just before 'to/after/related to'
card.fires_on: The last word of a named reaction or condition in a contraindication statement, such as dysfunction, reactions, angioedema or jaundice. It fires right where a phrase like 'associated with', 'after' or 'to' is expected.

modes.label: Hypersensitivity reactions
modes.description: The word reactions ends an allergy phrase in a contraindication list.
modes.example: History of asthma, urticaria, or allergic-type<< reactions>> after taking aspirin or other NSAIDs

modes.label: Angioedema history
modes.description: The final piece of angioedema in 'history of angioedema' before 'related to previous treatment'.
modes.example: , trandolapril and verapamil hydrochloride extended-release tablets are contraindicated in patients with a history of angioed<<ema>>

modes.label: Liver problems
modes.description: The end of a liver-related condition such as hepatic dysfunction or cholestatic jaundice.
modes.example: undice/Hepatic Dysfunction Clarithromycin is contraindicated in patients with a history of cholestatic jaundice or hepatic<< dysfunction>> associated with prior use of clarithrom
